system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: An episode-level alias map translates real tickers and dates to aliases when constructing the prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt built per-episode with masked identifiers and account state; no prompt file available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The initial prompt contains only account state and constraints, so the model must actively retrieve any market information through tools.
env_context_strategy.note: Default headline mode is open-research; fixed-candidate mode injects a curated factor table instead.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Observations areprice-only: OHLCV histories and derived technical features.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: provider-specific tool-call wire formats (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-native) are normalized in-side per-provider adapters

tool_count.evidence_quote: six read-only tools covering market context, candidate screening, per-stock snapshots, pairwise comparison, portfolio state, and pre-trade risk checks

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the model is forced via tool_choice to call submit_action and emit a JSON order list
edit_primitive.note: Trading benchmark; no file editing tools.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: six read-only tools covering market context, candidate screening, per-stock snapshots, pairwise comparison, portfolio state, and pre-trade risk checks (full interface in Appendix B, Table 6)

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The harness is provider-neutral:provider-specific tool-call wire formats (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-native) are normalized in-side per-provider adapters.
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: operates as a ReAct-style (Yao et al., 2023) loop with a strict two-phase structure
loop_primitives.note: Research phase then forced submission phase each trading day.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: ● Market context ● Candidate screening ● Factor ranking ● Inspection ● Compliance pre-check
planning_granularity.note: No stored plan object; research recipe only.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: an end-to-end agentic reasoning six retrieval tools
multi_agent_topology.note: One agent trader per episode (Figure 1: Agent Trader).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: At each trading step the agent observes account state, current positions, last-step execution results, benchmark-relative per-
short_term_state.note: The harness supplies typed account and position state at each step, beyond the message history. The quote spans a page break in the extracted text; the span is continuous in the excerpt.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Aliases are stable within an episode and shuffled across episodes to prevent within-run iden-tity reconstruction.
long_term_memory.note: No cross-run memory store described; design deliberately controls memory exposure.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The harness is deterministic given a seed, so any model is re-evaluable on identical conditions.

self_verification.evidence_quote: with up to three retries on schema or con-straint violations and a fallback to no-trade if all retries fail
self_verification.note: Schema/constraint validation only; no tests, critique or judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: rejected orders are logged but do not abort the step
retry_policy.note: Three retries are step-level schema retries, not task-level attempts.

rollback.evidence_quote: The sim-ulator logs all violations and execution outcomes so invalid LLM actions remain visible rather than being silently corrected.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: one contiguous long win-dow from 2024-01-01 to 2026-04-10 (548 trading days)
termination_condition.note: Episode ends when the fixed number of trading days is exhausted.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: LLM agents run via vendor APIs; the eighteen Qlib models train on one H800
cost_controls.note: No budget, routing, or caching mechanism described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: One LLM on the long window with three seeds takes 6–12 h wall-clock.
timeouts.note: Wall-clock reported but no enforced timeout described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: a Qlib-based stock-market executor with realistic constraints
execution_isolation.note: Actions are JSON orders executed by an in-process simulator, not shell commands.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The execution engine simulates A-share trading at realistic granularity
filesystem_access.note: No filesystem exposed to the agent; only simulated market data via tools.

network_policy.evidence_quote: six read-only tools covering market context, candidate screening, per-stock snapshots, pairwise com-parison, portfolio state, and pre-trade risk checks
network_policy.note: Agent has no network access; only the fixed tool interface.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The executor rejects orders that violate universe membership, position limits, T+1, or formatting constraints

tracing.evidence_quote: The sim-ulator logs all violations and execution outcomes so invalid LLM actions remain visible

replayability.evidence_quote: The harness is deterministic given a seed, so any model is re-evaluable on identical conditions.
replayability.note: Explicit determinism claim, though model sampling via vendor APIs.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we report a ten-dimensional metric panel grouped into three fam-ilies: returns and risk
